name: release-main-automation-demo
description: Dry-run demo for automated release-to-main post-release workflows.

scripts.validate:package: node -e "const pkg = require('./package.json'); if (!/^\d+\.\d+\.\d+([+-][0-9A-Za-z.-]+)?$/.test(pkg.version)) process.exit(1); console.log('Valid package version:', pkg.version)"
